name: Does homeowner's insurance cover mobile home water damage repair?

mainEntity.name: Does homeowner's insurance cover mobile home water damage repair?

acceptedAnswer.text: Most mobile home homeowner's insurance policies typically cover sudden and accidental water damage, such as a burst pipe or a storm-related leak. However, they generally do not cover damage resulting from neglect, poor maintenance, or gradual leaks that developed over time, like an unaddressed leaky faucet. Flood damage often requires a separate flood insurance policy. It's crucial to review your specific policy documents or contact your insurance provider to understand your coverage limitations and requirements before initiating any repairs.
acceptedAnswer.description: Insurance usually covers sudden water damage (e.g., burst pipes) but not neglect or gradual leaks. Flood damage often needs separate coverage. Check your policy.
